spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (हुडति)
To heap together, to collect or accumulate.
(ऋ) हुडृ r. 1st cl. (होडति)
To go or move.
(इ) हुडि r. 1st cl. (हुण्डते)
1 To heap, &c.
2 To accept, to agree to, or assent.
3 To take.

(ऋ) हूडृ r. 1st cl. (हूडति)
To go, to move.

m. (-डुः)
A ram.
E.
हुड to assemble, aff. कु.

m. (-क्कः)
1 A gallinule.
2 A drunken man.
3 A small hourglass-shaped drum.
4 A stick or staff, one bound with iron.
5 The bar of a door.
E.
हुडुक् imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. क.
